planning_notes: Board is UNO as specified. Pin wiring preserved: Button on D2, TM1637 using CLK=D4 and DIO=D5, LED on D13.

Button electrical polarity (active-high vs active-low) and pull-up/pull-down wiring were not provided; catalog default behavior is used. The model-level semantics assume the button input model becomes true when the button is pressed (do not invert in software again).
No serial reporting requirements were provided; serial_channels is empty.
Control period chosen as 5 ms for responsive button sampling and timely display/LED updates; business logic timing (counting/parity switching) is handled in the SysML model.
